pass: MAHPLAZA v4 — AAA closure + luminous crystalline night
note: Statuses are judged from the actual-runtime captures in this folder at 1280x720 and at phone size, not from intent.

gates.name: Night sky reads as night, not an empty black field
gates.note: v4-establishing-night-wide / v4-skyline-night-wide: a three-stop gradient with a lit horizon band, stars, moon, atmospheric depth layers and the district's glow. Night key values were raised (moon 1.35, hemi 1.5, fill 0.66, environment 0.92) so the world is filled with controlled light while staying deep in absolute value.

gates.name: Moonlight influences the atmosphere; diamond clouds present, volumetric AND crystalline
gates.note: clouds.js builds layered soft masses with crystalline internal planes lit by the moon direction. First integration read as hard shards; corrected to a soft-body-dominant balance with feathered, inset planes.

gates.name: Sky alive without being noisy
gates.note: Cloud drift and internal breathing are slow and per-layer; FOBEAM packets travel; nothing flashes. The chaos test (§63 of the previous brief, §44 here) holds: at most one ambient event is active at a time in the recorded log.

gates.name: City crystallized — not dark boxes; bevels catch light; windows vary; midtones survive
gates.note: Destinations gained a tapered faceted crown, angled crystal panels in recessed reveals, chamfered corner turns with platinum edges and a diamond roof beacon. Window brightness now has a wide spread with a cool drift and a lower lit fraction. Neutrals raised with higher envMapIntensity so dark planes keep reading.

gates.name: FOBEAMS — real paths, occlusion, core vs outer, square-diamond packets, direction, endpoints
gates.note: fobeam.js replaces the plain arcs: rail core + soft outer field, pooled square-diamond packets travelling with a travelling light, endpoint receivers, per-route direction and phase. Visible in v4-establishing-night-wide and v4-skyline-night-wide. Matches the app's canonical language (mygym.css:518-531, calendar.js:83: rail + square diamond + travelling light).

gates.name: Living world — restrained evidence of life within about a minute
gates.note: Recorded in capture.json.life: all eight ambient event types fire (levitation drill, bridge dash, training strike, projectile practice, gym-window silhouette, distant sparring, a group entering MAH MATCH, a resident leaving MAH MARKET) with 14-17 residents walking and never more than one event active. Headless browsers throttle animation frames below one per second, so the capture advances the world through the same step function the browser runs.

gates.name: Depth layers — foreground, midground, background, far background, sky
gates.note: city.js supplies midground blocks with bridges and a walkway, background crystalline towers and distant giants; plaza-dressing.js supplies the foreground; fog is a long time-of-day falloff rather than a bank.

gates.name: Plaza floor — material zones, panel divisions, paths, MAHGIC channels, no mirror
gates.note: A smoother civic disc inside the rougher outer field, eight faceted slab wedges at the transition, four inlaid MAHGIC routing channels, and inlaid path bands with curb lips from the marker to each destination.

gates.name: Character crystallization
gates.note: Residents gained continuous volume under the facets, a calmer torso painting and a soft contact blob that grounds each hovering figure. The near/mid/far LOD rebuild and the dedicated impostor in residents.js were not completed; life.js carries its own 60-triangle impostor for the far crowd, so the distant population is cheap but the LOD swap inside residents.js is still to do.

gates.name: Mobile readability
gates.note: Phone frames in this folder. Arrival and in-world views take a portrait override that raises the look target so the destinations and skyline hold the frame at 390x844.

gates.name: Performance discipline
gates.note: Draw calls and triangles per view are in capture.json; the whole world is merged per material or instanced, effects are pooled with a hard cap of six, and quality tiers move cost without losing composition. Frame times here come from software GL and are not phone numbers; no real-device measurement exists in this environment.

discrepancies: residents.js LOD tiers and createImpostor / setLOD were specified and documented in that file's header but not implemented; life.js supplies its own far-crowd impostor instead, so nothing is broken but the header overstates the module until that work lands.
Cloud shadows are not cast (brief §38 allows this); clouds contribute light through their own catches and the sky keys only.
The reserved square-diamond mark slot on the three signs is still empty: no verified FOB or MAHFITT mark file has been supplied.
Frame times in every capture come from headless software GL on a shared 4-core machine and are inflated; only draw calls, triangles, lights and shadow-caster counts are device-independent.
